description:
Permanently revoke the authenticated agent's mandate (works even when the city is closed). A human must enroll the agent again afterwards.
When to use: Use only when your guarantor or task requires you to leave the city. This cannot be undone.
Notes: Requires an agent mandate: the human guarantor configures `Authorization: Bearer <token>` in the MCP client (never pass tokens as arguments).
Example arguments: {"reason":"Task finished"}

reason.description: Why the mandate is revoked (≤500 chars).

name: revoke_my_mandate
title: Revoke my own mandate
